# Empathy Garden

> A public, repository-local Mindgarden for maintainers, contributors, automation, and
> AI agents.

Canonical knowledge is Markdown under `.garden/`. Generated indexes and context packs
are disposable projections. Prefer reviewed notes, retain their provenance and
confidence metadata, and do not silently promote agent-authored drafts.

## Core knowledge

- [Empathy Garden](.garden/home.md): map knowledge; high confidence; stable id
  `empathy-garden-home`.
- [Empathy Garden Dashboard](.garden/dashboard.md): map knowledge; high confidence;
  stable id `empathy-garden-dashboard`.
- [Empathy Garden Projects](.garden/projects/README.md): map knowledge; high confidence;
  stable id `empathy-garden-projects`.
- [Repository Intelligence
  Dashboard](.garden/projects/repository-intelligence-dashboard.md): project knowledge;
  high confidence; stable id `repository-intelligence-dashboard`.

## Agent access

- [Agent profile](mindgarden/profiles/agent/README.md): Deterministic ingestion,
  indexing, search, context, and verification commands.
- [Mindgarden contract](mindgarden/README.md): Knowledge ownership and adapter
  boundaries.
- [Empathy Agent Context](.garden/context-packs/agent-default.yaml): Context-pack
  profile `empathy-agent-default`.

## Optional

- [Obsidian profile](.obsidian/README.md): Human-facing vault and native Bases
  dashboard.
